name: Enraged Thunder Lizards
summary: In the southern Barrens, thunder lizards roam the plains around Camp Taurajo. Jorn Skyseer calls hunters to face the great beasts and bring back their blood as part of a wider rite of passage.

sections.title: A Test of the Southern Plains
sections.body: After defeating the raptor Ishamuhale, you return to Camp Taurajo. The tauren elder Jorn Skyseer now tests your strength against the largest grazers of the land. Stormsnouts and Thunderheads roam the southern Barrens, their heavy strides able to crush an unwary hunter beneath them.

sections.title: The Way of the Predator
sections.body: Tauren and orc hunters prize poise, position, and strength when facing a thunder lizard. Jorn asks you to bring back samples of their potent blood, proof that you stood in the path of the rumbling beasts and survived with your bones unbroken. The trophy opens the way to Jorn's final quarry in the skies.

faq.q: Where can I find the thunder lizards for this hunt?
faq.answer: Thunder lizards roam the plains around Camp Taurajo in the southern Barrens. Stormsnouts, Stormhides, and Thunderheads graze north, east, and south of the camp.

faq.q: Who sends me on this hunt?
faq.answer: Jorn Skyseer, a tauren elder and hunter at Camp Taurajo, sends you after the thunder lizards. The hunt follows your encounter with the swift raptor Ishamuhale.

faq.q: What makes thunder lizards particularly dangerous?
faq.answer: Their great size and electrical nature make thunder lizards dangerous. A careless hunter can be crushed underfoot or stunned by their storm-charged stomps.

faq.q: What does Jorn do with the blood collected?
faq.answer: Jorn uses the blood as proof that you faced and felled the creatures in close combat. He inspects it to see whether you survived their trampling with your bones intact.
Bring the blood to Jorn Skyseer, and he sends you after the winged predators of the plains in Cry of the Thunderhawk, the next stage of the southern hunting trials.

faq.q: How does this fit into Sergra Darkthorn's trials?
faq.answer: Sergra Darkthorn starts your hunting progression near the Crossroads in the northern Barrens. She sends you after plainstriders, zhevras, and raptors, then sends you south to Taurajo to learn from Jorn Skyseer against heavier game.

angles.text: As a Shu'halo, you honor the ancestral plains through the traditional hunt for great thunder lizards around Camp Taurajo. It tests your fortitude and balance.
As a hunter, you test your footwork against a thunder lizard, keeping clear of its crushing stomps while wearing down its immense hide.
As a member of the Horde, you help clear enraged beasts from the paths around Camp Taurajo, protecting caravans and traveling warriors in the southern Barrens.
